turns.text: I've been having stomach cramps and bloating lately.
Does this happen after eating dairy?
Now that you mention it, yes, especially after ice cream.
My nose has been stuffy and itchy for two weeks.
Is the discharge clear and watery?
Yes, and my eyes itch too.
I feel dizzy after sitting for long periods.
Do you feel faint or light-headed when standing up?
Yes, exactly, it happens when I stand up quickly.
I get a burning feeling in my chest after meals.
Does it get worse when you lie down?
Yes, especially at night.
I have facial pain and thick nasal discharge.
Do you also have a fever?
A mild one, yes.
My periods have been irregular for months.
Have you noticed acne or extra hair growth?
Yes, both actually.
Everything spins when I roll over in bed.
Do you have any hearing loss or ringing in your ears?
No, just the spinning.
I've had cramping and irregular bowel habits for months.
Does the pain improve after a bowel movement?
Yes, it usually does.
